name: PresentLong
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game prop, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, quirky proportions. A long low wrapped Christmas present box, twice as long as wide, puffy rounded edges, a ribbon around the middle and a star-shaped bow on top. Single object, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Purple wrapping paper with yellow polka dots, lime green ribbon, gold star bow. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: placePresent scales by the Box's largest side, so the size here only sets proportions.
